parser_facts: cli/risu_projection.py classifies a file as a Projection Adapter only when adapter_version == 0.7
therefore the invalid exit occurs before semantic verification because the generated adapter is outside the frozen v0.7 adapter grammar

correction.rationale: The frozen scientific core is v0.7 and accepts Projection Adapter grammar version 0.7. Infrastructure v0.8 is an execution-harness version and must not be written into the frozen core's adapter_version field.

allowed_changes: Change only adapter_base.adapter_version in Unit 002-R vbe.envelope.json from 0.8 to 0.7.

Mechanically update only dependent SHA-256/commit/blob pointers in vbe.instance.draft.json, vbe.instance.json, and AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json so they bind the corrected envelope and corrected draft bytes.
Add this Amendment 004 to AUTHOR_ACCEPTANCE.json amendments_applied and evidence_audit.

Generate a new primary manifest and readiness seal from the corrected committed bytes; preserve the previous manifest/seal and invalid-run identities in supersession records rather than treating them as a valid semantic primary.
forbidden_changes: Changing SOURCE_LANE.json or any source consequence, source coordinate, admissibility condition, or bounded world.
Changing TARGET_LANE.json or any target identity, target revision, callable surface fact, mechanism fact, runtime qualification fact, or evidence object.
Changing BOUNDARY_MODEL.json, effect cut, claim scope, or exclusions.

Changing the target pattern, target program expressions, fact statuses, provenance graph, evidence bindings, qualification bindings, structural template, Exact Realization settings, or desired semantic outcome.
Replacing, reordering, or reselecting the prospectively enrolled Unit 002 target.
Using the invalid run or parser inspection to infer, prefer, or repair toward PRESERVED, CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION, or INCOMPLETE_ASSURANCE.
scientific_interpretation: This amendment changes a protocol-version label required for the already-authored adapter to enter the frozen v0.7 verifier grammar. It does not change the consequence model that will be evaluated once a valid semantic execution occurs.

superseded_preprimary_readiness.supersession_reason: The first execution attempt exposed a frozen-core adapter grammar compatibility defect before any semantic verdict. These bytes remain immutable historical readiness evidence but are not eligible for a valid semantic primary after Amendment 004.
